writeup: This MUDEELA expandable pot lid organizer is $7.99 new. It stretches from 12.9 to 21.88 inches and comes with 10 adjustable dividers in white plastic, so lids, pans, plates, and cutting boards can stand in a cabinet instead of stacking. Mudeela's own site still sells the same rack for $21.99, Cleverwiz has it at $30.98, and CulinaHaus lists it at $49.90. That is about $14 and 63 percent below the brand's current price. Only three are left, with a limit of three per customer.
